verdict.rationale: First-party docs say notes are non-proprietary plain-text Markdown files stored locally, which other editors and file managers can open, and that Obsidian can be used offline (obsidian-docs-2, -20, -23, -38). Community users confirm they own their files and that the plain text can outlive the app (obsidian-comm-9, -20, -3). Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that every feature works fully offline, and one non-Markdown format (Canvas uses JSON files, still openly readable).
